meta.title: If we care about plastic waste, why won't we stop drinking bottled water?

paragraphs.text: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries, if you want to make money, you could do a lot worse than fill a bottle with water and sell it. A litre of tap water, the stuff we have cleverly piped into our homes, costs less than half a penny. A litre of bottled water can cost well over a pound, especially for something fancy that has been sucked through a mountain.

sentences.text: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries, if you want to make money, you could do a lot worse than fill a bottle with water and sell it.

analysis.translationLiteral: 尽管有界定食品饮料行业的种种创新和选择，如果你想赚钱，你本可以做比把水装进瓶子再卖掉糟糕得多的事。
analysis.translationNatural: 食品饮料行业花样再多，要说赚钱，最省事的莫过于灌一瓶水拿去卖。
analysis.structMarkup: (For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries), (if you want to make money), _you could do a lot worse than_ ~fill a bottle with water and sell it~.
analysis.structureSummary: 让步状语（For all...，含 that 定语从句）+ 条件状语从句（if）+ 主谓 + 比较结构（could do worse than）

components.part: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries
components.note: For all + 名词短语表让步「尽管」；that 引导定语从句修饰 innovation and choice

components.part: you could do a lot worse than

components.part: fill a bottle with water and sell it

phrases.usage: 注意区分：industries（复数/三单）/ industry（原形）。

paragraphs.text: Yet the bottled water market is livelier than ever. It defies our increasing awareness of the harm plastics do to the environment and a broader, growing sense that something has to change. Sales in the UK were worth a record £558.4 million this past year, an increase of 7%, according to the latest figures from the market analyst Kantar. Separate data from other analysts show that last year the British consumed more than 2.2 billion litres of bottled water, including "take-home" and "on-the-go" products. That's an annual rise in volume of 8.5%.

paragraphs.text: Environmental campaigners are struggling to understand why nations blessed with clean tap water grow only fonder of the bottle. "It's very surprising to me," says Sam Chetan-Walsh, a political adviser at Greenpeace and campaigner against ocean plastic. "Public awareness has never been higher, but the message is not quite reaching all the people it needs to." Where it is heard, the message is causing concern. Plastic water bottles require oceans of fossil fuels to make and ship. Additionally, single-use plastics of all types are polluting our cities and seas. paragraphs.text: So the plastic tide only creeps higher. The industry is quick to point out that all its bottles are recyclable. "But collection rates are, at the most generous estimates, 56%, so the actual recycling rate will be lower than that," Chetan-Walsh says. And while bottles may be recyclable, very few are made of recycled plastic. One water bottle company launched recycled half-litre "eco" bottles alongside its standard bottles. Another has pledged to use only recycled plastic across its range by 2025. Chetan-Walsh believes in a ban on single-use bottles. Bans do exist in some places. Organisers of a famous music festival announced that water bottles will not be sold this summer. San Francisco has banned them from city property and events. Last year, the UK government set out plans to ban single-use plastic from its estate.

注意区分：although + 从句 / despite + 名词。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用自问自答把「环保」打回原形，K 段以一点反讽收尾，也呼应全篇对塑料的质疑。

paragraphs.text: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough. "There is always this kind of slip between concern, intent and changed behaviour," says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water. "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day. Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it." Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force, it will be up to consumers to not only demand change—but to act themselves.

sentences.text: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough.

analysis.translationLiteral: 如同事情常常如此，聪明的营销能打败理性；意识很少是够的。
analysis.translationNatural: 老毛病又来了：营销总能压过道理，光有意识远远不够。
analysis.structMarkup: {As is so often the case}, 【clever marketing】 _can beat_ reason; awareness is rarely enough.
analysis.structureSummary: 非限制性定语从句（As 引导）+ 主谓宾；分号后为并列分句

components.part: As is so often the case
components.note: As 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句，意为「一如既往」
抽象名词作主语，谓语用 can beat
can 表可能性；beat 此处意为「胜过、压倒」
分号后独立分句；rarely 半否定，呼应第 39 题「lack reason」

clauses: 定语从句「As is so often the case」：As 引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句，意为「一如既往」
含否定或半否定成分；若置于句首，主句须部分倒装。

phrases.meaning: 事例、情况、案例；案件；箱子、盒（in case 万一）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：in case（万一，连词，从句用一般现在时表将来）/ in case of + 名词（假如发生，介词短语）/ in the case of（就…而言）/ in no case（绝不，置句首主句倒装）/ in any case（无论如何）。
phrases.example: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough. 老毛病又来了：营销总能压过道理，光有意识远远不够。

phrases.meaning: 市场、集市、行情、销路；营销、推销、上市（market 的现在分词/动名词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：marketing（现在分词/动名词）/ market（原形）。
phrases.example: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough. 老毛病又来了：营销总能压过道理，光有意识远远不够。

phrases.meaning: 足够的；足够地（置于形容词后）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：enough（足够的）/ enough 修饰形容词时后置：good enough。常见搭配：enough time / good enough。
phrases.example: There is not enough patience for long reading. 对长篇阅读耐心不够。

pitfalls: 否定副词置于句首时主句要部分倒装（助动词提前）。
注意区分：in case（万一，连词，从句用一般现在时表将来）/ in case of + 名词（假如发生，介词短语）/ in the case of（就…而言）/ in no case（绝不，置句首主句倒装）/ in any case（无论如何）。
注意区分：marketing（现在分词/动名词）/ market（原形）。
analysis.paragraphRole: L 段亮出全文总判断，正是第 39 题「面对高明营销，人往往不讲理」的落点。

sentences.text: "There is always this kind of slip between concern, intent and changed behaviour," says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water.

analysis.translationLiteral: 「在担忧、意图和改变了的行为之间总有这种脱节，」瓶装水分析师 Giles Quick 说。
analysis.translationNatural: 瓶装水分析师贾尔斯·奎克说：「担心、想改、真改了，中间老是掉链子。」
analysis.structMarkup: "_There is_ 【always this kind of slip】 (between concern, intent and changed behaviour)," says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water.
analysis.structureSummary: 直接引语（There be 句型）+ 引出语（含同位语）

components.note: There be 句型，表示存在
真正主语；slip 此处意为「脱节、落差」，不是「滑倒」

components.part: between concern, intent and changed behaviour
components.note: between 引出三者之间的落差

components.part: says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water
components.note: 主谓倒装，逗号后是同位语说明身份

clauses: There be 句型中 there 是引导词，真正的主语在 be 之后，谓语与之一致。
本句主干为「直接引语（There be 句型）+ 引出语（含同位语）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 担忧、关心、关切的事；涉及、关于、使担忧（concerned about）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：concern（关切、担忧，名词；涉及、使担忧，动词）/ be concerned about（担心…，介词 about）/ be concerned with（与…有关；关注…，介词 with）/ concerning（关于，介词）/ as far as … is concerned（就…而言）。
phrases.example: "There is always this kind of slip between concern, intent and changed behaviour," says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water. 瓶装水分析师贾尔斯·奎克说：「担心、想改、真改了，中间老是掉链子。」

phrases.meaning: say 的第三人称单数（说）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：says /sez/ 发音不按规则；注意与 say 的过去式 said /sed/ 区分。常见搭配：she says that / as the report says。
phrases.example: He says the change is coming. 他说变化正在到来。

phrases.meaning: 水（不可数）/ 浇水
phrases.usage: 注意区分：water（水，不可数）/ waters（水域）/ a water（一杯水）。常见搭配：water supply / drinking water。
phrases.example: Irrigation needs water. 灌溉需要水。

pitfalls: There be 句型谓语的单复数跟 be 后面的名词走。
注意区分：concern（关切、担忧，名词；涉及、使担忧，动词）/ be concerned about（担心…，介词 about）/ be concerned with（与…有关；关注…，介词 with）/ concerning（关于，介词）/ as far as … is concerned（就…而言）。
注意区分：says /sez/ 发音不按规则；注意与 say 的过去式 said /sed/ 区分。
analysis.paragraphRole: 借分析师之口给「知而不行」一个术语化说法，为下句的五蔬果例子铺路。

sentences.text: "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day. Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it."

analysis.translationLiteral: 「最好的例子是每日五份，即每天至少吃五份果蔬的建议。几乎人人都知道这一点，但我们中大约 15% 做得到。」
analysis.translationNatural: 他举的例子是「一天五份果蔬」：道理人人都懂，真做到的也就一成半。
analysis.structMarkup: "【The best example】 _is five a day_, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day. Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it."
analysis.structureSummary: 直接引语（主系表 + 同位语；并列句 but 连接两个分句）

components.note: 承接上句的「脱节」，引出例证
five a day 是固定健康口号，作表语

components.part: the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day
components.note: 解释 five a day；不定式作 recommendation 的后置定语

components.part: Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it
components.note: but 转折；something like 表约数，与 Almost everyone 形成数量反差

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「直接引语（主系表 + 同位语；并列句 but 连接两个分句）」。

phrases.meaning: 至少
phrases.usage: 修饰数量或程度，反义 at most（至多）。
phrases.example: It takes at least an hour. 至少要一小时。

phrases.meaning: 例子、实例；榜样
phrases.usage: 注意区分：for example（插入语，缩写 e.g.）/ such as（后接名词）。常见搭配：for example / an example of。
phrases.example: For example, texting and reading coexist. 例如，发短信和读书并存。

phrases.meaning: 五（数词）；五个、五岁（作定语或表语）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：five（五）/ fifth（第五）。常见搭配：five years ago / five times。
phrases.example: We did a study five years ago. 我们五年前做过一项研究。

pitfalls: at least 是副词短语，不修饰名词作定语。
注意区分：for example（插入语，缩写 e.g.）/ such as（后接名词）。
注意区分：five（五）/ fifth（第五）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用「人人知道、极少做到」的对照把「意识不够」坐实，支撑 L 段总判断。

sentences.text: Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force, it will be up to consumers to not only demand change—but to act themselves.

analysis.translationLiteral: 除非一项影响深远的瓶子禁令确实生效，否则将由消费者来不仅要求改变——而且自己行动。
analysis.translationNatural: 除非真来一场大范围禁瓶，否则指望不上别人：消费者既要喊变，也得自己动起来。
analysis.structMarkup: {Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force}, 【it】 _will be up to_ consumers (to not only demand change—but to act themselves).
analysis.structureSummary: 条件状语从句（Unless 引导）+ it 形式主语 + 主系表 + not only...but... 并列不定式

components.part: Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force
components.note: Unless 意为「除非」；does 强调谓语动词；come into force 意为「生效」
形式主语，真正主语是后面的不定式
be up to sb 意为「由某人决定、取决于某人」

components.part: to not only demand change—but to act themselves
components.note: not only...but... 连接两个不定式；破折号前的长破折号是卷面原文

clauses: 状语从句「Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force」：Unless 意为「除非」；does 强调谓语动词；come into force 意为「生效」
句中含从属连词引导状语从句，说明原因、目的、条件或时间。
含否定或半否定成分；若置于句首，主句须部分倒装。

phrases.meaning: 不仅
phrases.usage: 常与 but also 呼应；not only 置于句首时主句要部分倒装。
phrases.example: Not only did he agree, he also helped. 他不但同意，还帮了忙。

phrases.meaning: 多达；取决于；由……决定
phrases.usage: 多义短语，需按语境判断。
phrases.example: It's up to you to decide. 由你来决定。

pitfalls: not only 置于句首时，所在分句要部分倒装。
up to 表数量时意为「多达」，表责任时意为「由……决定」。
because 引导从句，because of 后只能接名词；两者不能混用。
否定副词置于句首时主句要部分倒装（助动词提前）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 把责任从「禁令」交回「消费者」，以行动呼吁收束全篇。

questions.stem: Judging from the slowing rate of sales growth, there is still hope to combat bottled water.
Bottled water manufacturers base their arguments against bans of plastic bottles on health concerns rather than on profits.
Sales of bottled water in Britain hit a record high last year even though people are increasingly aware that plastics are environmentally unfriendly.
It often happens that people can lack reason when faced with skillful marketing.
One city on the west coast of America has banned single-use bottles from its property and events.
Manufacturing and shipping of plastic water bottles consume a tremendous amount of fossil fuels.
One large beverage company has adapted its operations when confronted with challenges from health and environmental advocates.
Bottled water is considerably more expensive than tap water.
Fountains could be seen in cities before bottled water became popular.
More people have taken to bottled water because of their health awareness.

examples: According to the study, rates are stable. 根据这项研究，比率稳定。

more.confusables: according to（根据，后接来源）/ because of（因为）

examples: She achieved her goal in two years. 她两年内实现了目标。

more.confusables: achieve / achieved / achieving（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

act.sense: 行动、做事；表演、扮演；行为、法令（本文 consumers to not only demand change—but to act themselves 消费者不仅要呼吁改变，更要自己行动）
examples: Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force, it will be up to consumers to not only demand change—but to act themselves. 除非真来一场大范围禁瓶，否则指望不上别人：消费者既要喊变，也得自己动起来。

more.confusables: act / actually / activity（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

actual.sense: 实际的、真实的、现存的（in actual fact 事实上）
examples: "But collection rates are, at the most generous estimates, 56%, so the actual recycling rate will be lower than that," Chetan-Walsh says. 切坦-沃尔什回击：「回收率往宽了算也才 56%，真正再利用的比例只会更低。」

more.confusables: actual / actually（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

examples: Kids adapt quickly to new tools. 孩子对新工具适应很快。

more.roots: ad-（朝向）+ apt（适合，词根，同 aptitude/apt）
more.confusables: adapt（适应/改编）/ adopt（采用/收养）——拼写极易混

add.sense: 添加、增加；补充说；把…加起来（add to 增加；本文 adding to all the health dangers 加剧各种健康风险 / add flavouring 加调味剂）
examples: And if you must fill them with tap water, why not add flavouring? 末了还不忘调侃：实在要灌自来水，加点调料不就行了？

more.confusables: add / adding / additional（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

adding.sense: 添加、增加；补充说（add 的现在分词；本文 consumers add flavours 消费者再加调味 / adding to... 增添）
examples: Last month one chief executive of a water bottling company said that bans would "result in greater consumption of sugary drinks, adding to all the health dangers of obesity, diabetes and tooth decay". 上个月某水企老总放话：禁了瓶装水，人们会改喝更多含糖饮料，肥胖、糖尿病、蛀牙这些风险只会更重。

more.confusables: adding / additional / additionally（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

additionally.sense: 此外、另外、加之（用于补充递进；本文 Additionally, single-use plastics... 此外，各类一次性塑料…）
examples: Additionally, single-use plastics of all types are polluting our cities and seas. 另外，各种一次性塑料正把城市和海洋弄脏。

more.confusables: additionally / additional（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

adviser.sense: 顾问、忠告者（= advisor；本文 a political adviser at Greenpeace 绿色和平组织的政治顾问）
examples: "It's very surprising to me," says Sam Chetan-Walsh, a political adviser at Greenpeace and campaigner against ocean plastic. 绿色和平的政治顾问、反海洋塑料运动者萨姆·切坦-沃尔什直说：「我真觉得意外。」
Tap water consumption is growing at roughly the same pace (UK consumers still drink almost three times as much tap water as bottled water). 自来水用量也在同步涨；括号里补一句：英国人喝的自来水仍差不多是瓶装水的三倍。

alongside.sense: 在…旁边、沿着…边；与…一起、同时
examples: One water bottle company launched recycled half-litre "eco" bottles alongside its standard bottles. 有家水企在常规款之外，另出了一款半升的再生「环保瓶」。

alternatives.sense: 可供选择的事物、替代方案（复数；本文 the alternatives are so obvious 替代瓶装水的选择如此明显 / considered their alternatives）
examples: Chetan-Walsh argues that bottled water is different because the alternatives are so obvious. 切坦-沃尔什认为瓶装水特殊：别的塑料品难替，它却明摆着有自来水可换。
Although these accounts touch on real concerns, they miss the whole. 尽管这些报道触及真实担忧，却忽略了全貌。

more.confusables: although + 从句 / despite + 名词

always.sense: 总是、一直、永远；始终（本文指「总是成为他人的囚徒」）
examples: "There is always this kind of slip between concern, intent and changed behaviour," says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water. 瓶装水分析师贾尔斯·奎克说：「担心、想改、真改了，中间老是掉链子。」

analyst.sense: 分析师、分析员（本文 the market analyst Kantar 市场分析机构凯度 / an analyst of bottled water 瓶装水行业分析师）
examples: Sales in the UK were worth a record £558.4 million this past year, an increase of 7%, according to the latest figures from the market analyst Kantar. 据凯度最新数据，英国过去一年瓶装水销售额创下 5.584 亿英镑的纪录，涨了 7%。

more.confusables: analyst / analysis / analysed（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

analysts.sense: 分析师（复数；本文 Separate data from other analysts / the latest analyst data 分析师最新数据）
examples: Separate data from other analysts show that last year the British consumed more than 2.2 billion litres of bottled water, including "take-home" and "on-the-go" products. 另几家机构的数据还显示：英国人一年喝掉 22 亿升以上瓶装水，家里喝的和路上买的都算。

more.confusables: analysts / analyst（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

announced.sense: 宣布、公布、通告（announce 的过去式 / 过去分词；本文 Organisers announced that water bottles will not be sold 主办方宣布停售瓶装水）
examples: Organisers of a famous music festival announced that water bottles will not be sold this summer. 某知名音乐节的主办方已经放了话：今年夏天不卖瓶装水。

annual.sense: 每年的、一年一度的、年度的（本文 an annual rise in volume of 8.5% 销量年增 8.5% / annual report）
examples: That's an annual rise in volume of 8.5%. 换算成销量，同比涨了 8.5%。

argues.sense: 主张、论证、争辩；争论、争吵（第三人称单数）
examples: Chetan-Walsh argues that bottled water is different because the alternatives are so obvious. 切坦-沃尔什认为瓶装水特殊：别的塑料品难替，它却明摆着有自来水可换。

more.confusables: argues / arguments / argument（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

asked.sense: 问、询问；要求、请求；邀请（ask 的过去式/过去分词）
examples: Kinvara Carey, general manager of an association of the biggest bottled water manufacturers, cites a survey in which people were asked what they would do if bottled water were not available. 大型瓶装水厂商协会的总经理金瓦拉·凯里搬出一份问卷：假如买不到瓶装水，人们会怎么办？

association.sense: 协会、社团；关联、联想、交往（本文 general manager of an association of... 某行业协会的总经理）
examples: Kinvara Carey, general manager of an association of the biggest bottled water manufacturers, cites a survey in which people were asked what they would do if bottled water were not available. 大型瓶装水厂商协会的总经理金瓦拉·凯里搬出一份问卷：假如买不到瓶装水，人们会怎么办？

more.roots: association 含 -tion / -sion（名词后缀，表动作或状态）

available.sense: 可获得的、可用的；有空的
examples: The data is available online. 这些数据可以在线获取。

more.confusables: available（可用的）/ accessible（可接近的）

aware.sense: 意识到的、知道的（be aware of / be aware that；本文 Almost everyone is aware of this 几乎人人都知道这一点）
examples: "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day. Almost everyone is aware of this, but something like 15% of us achieve it." 他举的例子是「一天五份果蔬」：道理人人都懂，真做到的也就一成半。

more.confusables: aware / awareness（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

awareness.sense: 意识、认识、知晓（本文 public / environmental / health awareness 公众 / 环保 / 健康意识，self-awareness 自我觉察）
examples: It defies our increasing awareness of the harm plastics do to the environment and a broader, growing sense that something has to change. 大家越来越清楚塑料害环境、也越来越觉得该改了，可销量偏偏不买账。

more.roots: awareness 含 -ness（名词后缀，表性质或状态）

back.sense: 背部、后面；后面的；回原处、向后；支持、后退（本文按语境取义）
examples: The packets? Not so much, and, yes, they are made of plastic, although the company invites users to post them back for recycling. 可调味包就没那么环保了——没错，还是塑料做的；公司只说「欢迎寄回来回收」。

more.confusables: back / background（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

more.confusables: vegetables / vegetable（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

volume.sense: 量、总额、体积、容积、音量；一卷、一册；大量
examples: That's an annual rise in volume of 8.5%. 换算成销量，同比涨了 8.5%。

want.sense: 想要（want to do / want sb to do）；需要
examples: They want to appear more adult. 他们想显得更成熟。

more.confusables: want to do（想要）/ need to do（需要）/ would like to do（更礼貌）

examples: Irrigation needs water. 灌溉需要水。

more.confusables: water（水，不可数）/ waters（水域）/ a water（一杯水）

well.sense: 好地（副词）；健康的（形容词）；井（名词）
examples: Social health matters to overall well-being. 社交健康关系到整体幸福。

more.confusables: well（好地/健康）/ good（好的，形容词）/ as well（也）

whole.sense: 整个的、全部的、完整的；整体、全部（as a whole 总体上；the whole of）

more.confusables: whole（整个的，作定语：the whole + 单数名词 / the whole of + 名词）/ all（语序不同：all the day = the whole day，all 在冠词前、whole 在冠词后）/ on the whole（总体上）/ as a whole（作为整体）/ hole（洞，同音 /həʊl/）

examples: "If a product that is so nakedly unnecessary can exist, then the whole system is failing," he says. 他撂下一句：「连这种一看就多余的东西还能大行其道，只能说明整套机制出了问题。」

wildlife.sense: 野生动植物、野生生物（不可数；本文 name more...than wildlife species 说出游戏角色比野生物种还多 / save wildlife）
examples: Numerous documentaries have shown how plastic is ultimately killing wildlife. 不少纪录片都拍过：塑料到头来会要了野生动物的命。

without.sense: 没有、不带（后接名词或动名词）
examples: Without making things complicated, the answer is simple. 不把事情弄复杂的话，答案很简单。

more.confusables: without doing（介词 + 动名词）/ without 不接从句（除非 without that，罕见）

work.sense: 工作；运转、奏效 / 工作、作品
examples: The approach works in practice. 这个方法在实践中奏效。

more.confusables: work（工作，不可数）/ job（职位，可数）/ works（工厂；作品）

worse.sense: 更坏的、更差的、更糟的；更差地、更糟（bad / badly 的比较级；worse still 更糟的是）
examples: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries, if you want to make money, you could do a lot worse than fill a bottle with water and sell it. 食品饮料行业花样再多，要说赚钱，最省事的莫过于灌一瓶水拿去卖。

more.confusables: worse / worsen（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

worth.sense: 值得的、有…价值的（be worth doing）；价值、意义；值…（本文按语境取义）

more.confusables: worth（值得的，只作表语，be worth + 名词/doing，主动形式表被动，如 The book is worth reading）/ worthy（值得的，作定语或 be worthy of）/ worthwhile（值得做的，可作表语/定语）/ valuable（有价值的）/ be worth it

examples: Sales in the UK were worth a record £558.4 million this past year, an increase of 7%, according to the latest figures from the market analyst Kantar. 据凯度最新数据，英国过去一年瓶装水销售额创下 5.584 亿英镑的纪录，涨了 7%。
Red Rum returned the very next year. 「红朗姆」在第二年又回来了。

more.confusables: year（年）/ ear（耳朵）

yet.sense: 尚、还（否定/疑问句）；然而（连词）
examples: Yet studies suggest these anxieties are misplaced. 然而研究表明这些焦虑没有根据。

more.confusables: yet（尚/然而）/ already（已经）/ but（但是）
